inlines.v: ANACREON'TIC, adjective Pertaining to Anacreon, a Greek poet, whose odes and epigrams are celebrated for their delicate, easy and graceful air, and for their exact imitation of nature. His verse consists of three feet and a half, usually spondees and iambuses, sometimes anapests; as in this line of Horace. 'Lydia, dic per omnes.' ANACREON'TIC, noun A poem composed in the manner of Anacreon.
